# `when` = on <cell> fires on every change of that cell while `if` is true. `on event` fires on `event <name>` actions.
# `when` = at <time> [days] fires on a clock: at 08:00 daily, at 07:00 mon-fri, at sunset-30m (sunrise/sunset take +/- offsets).
# `then` holds one or more actions separated by `;`. `enabled` = no disables a row (used during migration).
